body:
Real SDL_DROPFILE event plumbing end-to-end: EventKind gains FileDrop(path), spawn_new_instance() opens each dropped file in a genuinely new editor process/window (fork+execl on POSIX, CreateProcessA on Windows), matching founder's explicit scope ('for now is fine it can open a new window with that file'). SIGCHLD,SIG_IGN added so fire-and-forget children don't zombie. executable_path()/executable_dir() added (GetModuleFileNameA/_NSGetExecutablePath/proc-self-exe readlink) and used to make font lookup CWD-independent — directly fixes the double-black-screen Windows launch failure the founder hit testing this build. CI green on Linux/Windows/macOS. Released as v0.77.0.

⚓ ☃
title: v0.77.0: real drag-and-drop file opening + exe-relative font path
